resources.string: Use if hardware double-tap function is not working.

This is not a direct kernel integration, but a software hook.

Note:
• Software waits for a second tap in Doze/AOD mode.
Double Tap to Sleep on Launcher (DT2S)
Tap an empty area on the launcher to lock the device.

System value: %1$d px.

Enter 0 to use system value.
Enter 1-600 for custom setting.
The allowed range is 10 to 1000 ms.

This is not a direct launcher integration, but a software hook.

Note:
• The recommended tap interval is 150 ms to avoid false triggers.
• Intended for Pixel Launcher.
• MAY trigger unexpectedly.
• If you are on the homescreen and pull down the notification shade, DT2S will also trigger in the shade.
• DT2S will trigger in the App Drawer.
• DT2S will trigger if you double-tap an app icon or any other area.
• DT2S will NOT trigger when you open the App Drawer and start typing to search.
• DT2S will NOT trigger in Google Feed if you open it by swiping from the homescreen.
• This is a background service that listens for screen touches. The trigger area has been reduced by 15\% from the top and 20\% from the bottom of the screen. Taps for sleep will not be registered in these reduced areas.
Reboot is not required. Based on tests, the configuration is applied immediately, but restarting the device is recommended to guarantee stability.
A device reboot is required for this configuration to be applied correctly. Without a reboot, unstable CPU frequencies or incorrect charging behavior may occur.
"• Standard thermal limits for the battery. • Ensures maximum safety and longevity."
"• Slight increase in battery temperature limits (threshold raised by +5°C). • Moderately improves performance in warm conditions and reduces charging slowdown."
"• Balanced increase in battery temperature limits (threshold raised by +9°C). • Improves charging speed and performance while maintaining a reasonable safety level."
"⚠️ WARNING: Significant increase in battery temperature limits (threshold raised by +15°C). • May cause severe heating, accelerated wear, and potential battery damage."
"⚠️ EXTREME DANGER: Practical complete disabling of battery thermal control (threshold raised by +90°C). ❗ Use at your own risk. May cause overheating, irreversible damage, and void your warranty."
"• Standard value. • Aggressive thermal throttling for maximum temperature control and stability."
"• Slight relaxation of thermal throttling (threshold raised by +5°C). • Moderately increases performance at the cost of slightly higher heat."
"• Balanced relaxation of thermal throttling (threshold raised by +9°C). • Optimal compromise between high performance and manageable heat."
"⚠️ WARNING: Aggressive relaxation of thermal throttling (threshold raised by +15°C). • Provides maximum performance but may cause severe chassis heating and system instability."

"⚠️ EXTREME DANGER: Practical complete disabling of SoC thermal control (threshold raised by +90°C). ❗ Leads to extreme heating, instability, potential component damage, and warranty voidance. Use for testing purposes only."
